title: Selling 60k game assets bundle
author: PixelatedRainDrops
selftext:
Hi everyone,

I'm selling a large game assets bundle for just $12.

The bundle includes:

• 2D game assets

• 3D game assets

• Audio assets

• Multiple asset categories and styles

• 3D formats: OBJ, FBX, and GLB 

And moreee!

Perfect for indie developers, hobbyists, game jams, prototypes, and commercial projects.

If you're interested or would like to see previews/screenshots of the assets, feel free to send me a message.
